title: More control over Seedream and Seedance
summary:
Seedream and Seedance gained clearer model choices, audio and image requests got fixes, and thirteen community projects joined the directory.

Image and video generation gained separate standard and pro model choices. `seedream` selects Seedream 4.0, while `seedream-pro` selects 4.5 with 4K and multi-image support. `seedance` selects Lite, and `seedance-pro` selects Pro-Fast. Seedance usage and pricing displays now use video tokens rather than seconds.

`openai-audio` now has a 2,500-character input limit and a 512-token completion limit. Its input-length errors point to Enter for full audio capabilities, and an auth-page notice describes a move by Dec. 8. The simple GET text endpoint also now detects audio-output models, fixing 400 responses for requests such as `openai-audio`.

Thirteen projects joined the directories, spanning SAGE’s Android creative workflows, LineSketch AI’s line art, MindFlow’s searchable notes, TeleChars AI’s Telegram characters, and more chat, creative, and game experiments. The Projects page submission button now opens the current app-submission form.

daily.title: Two Seedream image options
daily.text: Choose `seedream` for Seedream 4.0 or `seedream-pro` for Seedream 4.5 with 4K and multi-image support. [Browse models](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=seedream-pro).

daily.title: Seedance Lite and Pro
daily.text: Choose `seedance` for Lite video generation or `seedance-pro` for Pro-Fast. Both support up to 10-second videos. [Browse models](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=seedance-pro).
